name: 0046 block 0 - bare floor 30 min
description: BLOCK 0, THE REFERENCE FLOOR. Sensors powered at their operating point (24 VDC switch-mode PSU AND slip-ring ~5 VDC PSU both ON) but nothing driving them: VFD fully powered down at the MAINS (not merely un-commanded -- an idle VFD's DC bus and switching are still live), motor off, heater relay open. No extra bench gear powered near the sensor cabling. Every later block is read as a delta against this. THIS PROFILE DOES NOT TOUCH THE DRIVE. The rpm schedule is deliberately empty and vfd_stop_on_end is false, so the runner never sends a frequency, never starts and never stops the motor -- the operator is in control of the drive by hand. It only acquires, for the stated duration, and logs telemetry. Ticket 0046 electrical-noise characterization. Same acquisition and scope_channels as a normal run, so blocks compare without rescaling. Heater relay must be OFF for every electrical block (it is its own EMI source, ticket 0035) -- it only comes back as its own factor in block 6.
